rule: Rows under source-intake/rab-sector/docs are never live intake.
Any field containing MISSING rejects the row.
Rows must include coefficient_symbol, coefficient_value, coefficient_units, normalization_convention, parent_action_block, source_path, source_anchor, and arena_projection.
source_path must be non-placeholder and resolve to a local source file for this private checkpoint.
source_anchor must be non-placeholder and appear in source_path text.
valid_for_claim=true or claim_allowed=true rejects a row in this private phase.
arena_projection must map the row to R10, PPN, clock, orbital, or all.
